what: JC-CA-03 BLOCKED, reported to the manager rather than improvised (per the dispatch). The operator chose option B, 'Use GITHUB_TOKEN' in r4-demotion-gate.yml so the PR author is really github-actions[bot]. MEASURED 2026-09-28, it has no clean route: (1) A GITHUB_TOKEN-opened PR gets no required checks here. #13001's head 7077d9e1 (opened by github-actions[bot]) got pull_request runs for Guards / pytest-run / pytest-collect / repo-inventory with 0 jobs, concluded failure, and 0 check runs under those names. (2) Workaround 'the producer dispatches the required workflows': GITHUB_TOKEN CAN dispatch (r4-demotion-gate run 36311893484, actor github-actions[bot], success). But the check runs do NOT satisfy branch protection. On probe PR #13502 (an empty commit with [skip ci], only dispatched runs) guards / pytest-collect / pytest-run were all success on the head SHA from app github-actions, yet mergeable_state=blocked. Control PR #13508 at the same moment, with the same contexts from pull_request, read clean. n=1 per arm. (3) Even if they had counted, a dispatched guards run skips every pr_only step (scripts/ci/run_guards.py:2282), which includes pr-landing-guard's real check and mandate-autoland-guard's R16 / A7. The required 'guards' would go green WITHOUT re-deriving the eight clauses, which removes the independent merge-time check the route's safety rests on. (4) FINDING, whichever option is chosen: A7's 'PR author == github-actions[bot]' is FORGEABLE. pr-opener.yml opens ANY session-pushed head branch with GITHUB_TOKEN, so the PR author is github-actions[bot] (read .github/workflows/pr-opener.yml). The commit-author check only compares git config emails. check_mandate_autoland.py's own docstring says A7 rests on 'a repo secret no session holds', and that is false for both tokens. Unforgeable provenance would be A7 verifying the run itself: GET /repos/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id} must have path == .github/workflows/r4-demotion-gate.yml, head_branch main, and a status from that run. A session cannot mint a run of that workflow that computes a different diff. RECOMMENDATION: the operator's option A (provenance-based A7 exception), keeping the PAT so checks attach, with the provenance being that run-id API read rather than the PAT-owner login.
